tool_description: Background task scheduler. Runs daily system health reports, morning repo scans and hourly log summaries automatically. Schedules persist in scheduler_config.json across restarts. Tasks can be added via conversation.

available_commands.description: List all scheduled tasks and their next run times
Add a new scheduled task. schedule: 'cron' or 'interval'. task_fn: system_health_report, repo_scan, log_summary or empty for custom prompt.
Remove a scheduled task by ID
Run a scheduled task immediately outside its normal schedule
Enable or disable a task without removing it

tool_usage_guidance: Three default tasks run automatically: daily health (9:00am), repo scan (9:15am), log summary (every hour)
Use list_tasks to see all tasks and when they next run
Use run_now to trigger any task immediately for testing
Use enable_task with false to pause a task without deleting it
Schedules are saved to scheduler_config.json and survive restarts
proactive_triggers: When a scheduled task fires and produces results
When user asks 'what tasks are scheduled?' or 'run the health report now'
When user asks to schedule something at a specific time
When user asks to disable or remove a scheduled task

metadata.notes: Default tasks created on first run. Edit scheduler_config.json to manually configure schedules.
